jobs.title: Staff Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
Montgomery \& Associates (M\&A) is seeking a full\-time, early career staff hydrogeologist to join our California team.
Founded in 1984 and headquartered in Tucson, Arizona, M\&A is a growing firm of respected water\-resource professionals expanding across the western U.S. and South America. Our California team comprises 24 professionals across four offices — Oakland, Sacramento, Monterey, and Pasadena. This position, based in **Sacramento or Oakland**, supports groundwater quality restoration and groundwater resource planning and implementation projects statewide, with a strong emphasis on Northern California and the Central Valley. Staff work at least 50% in\-office to promote collaboration and mentoring.
**What You'll Do**
* Work closely with an enthusiastic team of water resource professionals and clients on a diverse range of projects
* Lead project tasks in close collaboration with project managers and technical advisors
* Analyze and interpret hydrogeologic data to support the development of hydrogeologic conceptual models and numerical models
* Participate in field projects, including well drilling and testing and monitoring programs
* Prepare project reports and work plans

**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in hydrology, geology, earth sciences, civil engineering, or environmental engineering; graduate degree and professional geologist or engineer license are beneficial.
**Required Qualifications**
* **2 years** of professional experience with hydrogeologic principles applied to characterizing and assessing groundwater systems; familiarity with the Sustainable Groundwater Management Act is beneficial
* Experience with standard analytical tools like Microsoft Excel and geographic information systems (GIS); familiarity with computer scripting and hydrologic modeling software are beneficial
* Experience preparing technical reports and presenting work during group meetings with coworkers and clients
* Strong organizational, communication, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills; team\-oriented
* Interest in professional organizations, including presenting at conferences

**Your benefits at Montgomery \& Associates will include:**
* Competitive benefits and salary in an expanding team\-oriented company
* Dynamic work environment with safety and technical training provided by the company
* Interesting and collaborative multidisciplinary projects
* On the job mentoring by senior professionals
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible Spending Account; HRA
* Long\- and short\-term disability
* Life/AD\&D insurance
* Vacation, holiday, personal, and sick leave
* Employer matching 401k retirement plan

**Compensation**
Monthly Base Pay Range: $7,000 \- $8,000
Estimated Annualized Compensation Including Bonuses: $95,000 \- $110,000
*Compensation for qualified extra hours could increase annual compensation.*
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer
*M\&A values diversity and inclusivity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, religious creed, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
Montgomery \& Associates (M\&A) is seeking a full\-time hydrogeologist to join our California team in a project\-leadership role. You'll **manage tasks and projects**, lead technical work, mentor junior staff, and work directly with clients, regulators, and M\&A project leaders — with a central focus on Sustainable Groundwater Management Act (SGMA) planning and implementation.
Founded in 1984 and headquartered in Tucson, Arizona, M\&A is a growing firm of respected water\-resource professionals expanding across the western U.S. and South America. Our California team comprises 24 professionals across four offices — Oakland, Sacramento, Monterey, and Pasadena. This position, based in **Sacramento or Oakland**, supports groundwater resource planning and SGMA implementation statewide, with a strong emphasis on Northern California and the Central Valley. Staff work at least 50% in\-office to promote collaboration and mentoring.
**What You'll Do**
* Manage and technically lead multi\-disciplinary hydrogeology and groundwater resource tasks, with a primary focus on SGMA planning and implementation
* Collaborate with our groundwater modeling team to develop hydrogeologic conceptual models and numerical models
* Design and manage field investigations, well drilling and testing, and monitoring programs, and interpret hydrogeologic data
* Prepare technical reports, proposals, and work plans; review deliverables and mentor junior staff

* Proficiency with standard analytical tools; demonstrated technical writing and group/client presentation skills
* Strong organizational, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills; team\-oriented, with experience delegating and reviewing staff deliverables

jobs.title: Data Analyst II, Reporting & Advanced Analytics Part Time 26-84
jobs.description:
**We’re delighted you’re considering joining us!**


At Hill Physicians Medical Group, we’re shaping the healthcare of the future: actively managed care that prevents disease, supports those with chronic conditions and anticipates the needs of our members.

**Join Our Team!**


Hill Physicians has much to offer prospective employees. We’re regularly recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work in the Bay Area” and have been recognized as one of the “Healthiest Places to Work in the Bay Area.” When you join our team, you’re making a great choice for your professional career and your personal satisfaction.

**DE\&I Statement:**


At PriMed, your uniqueness is valued, celebrated, encouraged, supported, and embraced. Whatever your relationship with Hill Physicians, we welcome ALL that you are.


We value and respect your race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, disabilities, experiences, perspectives, and other attributes. Our celebration of diversity and foundation of inclusion allows us to leverage our differences and capitalize on our similarities to better serve our communities. We do it because it's right!

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The Data Analyst **Part Time** supports data\-informed initiatives, including clinical quality, financial performance, and population health by gathering, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data as a compelling story to the Hill Physicians team and its collaborating partners. Within this classification, analysts may focus on reporting and visualization, or analytical consultation and modeling. Data Analysts work as members of teams committed to using and promoting industry\-standard best practices and to addressing new problems with innovative solutions.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Transform data into actionable insights with narrative to drive strategic and operational decisions
* Conduct driver analysis to identify key factors influencing health outcomes and predict future utilization of health care services
* Provide consultation to internal stakeholders in understanding and responding to HPMG performance as measured by external bodies, e.g., health plans and the Integrated Healthcare Association, as well as variations in internal clinical and financial metrics
* Assist internal and external stakeholders with appropriate use of standardized reports, analytical approaches to population management and quality improvement programs, and program effectiveness evaluation
* Serve as analytical liaison with internal stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of data requirements and fostering collaboration to drive data\-driven decision\-making
* Use business understanding to appropriately implement logic specifications
* Independently develop analytic plan to address business questions
* Prepare presentations for non\-technical audiences
* Provide guidance and support to junior analysts, helping them develop their skills and understanding of data analysis and familiarity with data sets
* Utilize advanced querying techniques for complex data manipulation and statistical analyses

**Data Governance \& Compliance**

* Proactively perform quality assurance on all deliverables including researching and reconciling data discrepancies occurring among various information systems and reports
* Maintain high data quality standards to ensure that reports and analyses are accurate, timely, and reliable, enabling confident decision\-making
* Improve the organization’s quality assurance procedures
* Collaborate with appropriate IT teams and business stewards to improve the quality of data and information flows at Hill Physicians
* Ensure compliance with data governance frameworks and healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA

**Knowledge, Experience \& Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, business, informatics, statistics, public health, or related field with coursework in quantitative analysis
* Master’s degree preferred
* Minimum 3 years of professional analytics\-related experience.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment, prioritize multiple projects and problem\-solve under tight deadlines and resource constraints
* Excellent written and interpersonal communication skills and presentation skills, including ability to present complex technical concepts in a clear, concise manner to audiences with varying levels of technical understanding
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and to function as an integral part of a team in a rapidly changing work environment, and to operate effectively with limited direction from management
* Intermediate understanding of healthcare\-specific datasets, including claims, clinical, and authorization data, with the ability to perform data extraction and analysis.
* Can independently solve moderately complex analytic problems and generate insights that inform decision\-making within specific business areas
* Understanding of data pipelines from source systems (e.g. EPIC) into data warehousing or other downstream data sources
* Experience with chronic disease identification, utilization trending, outlier analysis, quality metrics, and tracking of other health performance indicators.
* Proficiency in Microsoft suite, including pivot tables and advanced formulas and functions
* Proficiency in querying languages such as SQL
* Experience with advanced data visualization tools such as Tableau or GIS software (ArcGIS) preferred
* Experience with advanced analytic programs/languages such as SAS or R preferred

**Additional Information:**


Salary: $48,700\.00 \- $63,925\.00 Annual

**Hill Physicians is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Environmental Field Technician - I
jobs.description:
About the Company

Looking for an exciting opportunity to grow with a dynamic and expanding environmental company? Look no further than JLM Environmental. We are one of Southern California’s fastest\-growing environmental inspection companies, having performed over 42,000 inspections since 2011, and are actively seeking driven team members to help us achieve our ongoing growth goals. Our company culture is second to none, and you’ll enjoy working alongside a team of motivated professionals in a family\-owned and operated atmosphere.

At JLM Environmental, we specialize in conducting safe and efficient inspections for hazardous materials such as asbestos, lead, mold, and radon. We provide these services across a range of properties, including residential homes, commercial buildings, schools, and churches throughout Southern California.

We encourage our associates to grow with us by promoting cross\-training throughout our ever\-expanding firm, including opportunities within our federally accredited in\-house laboratory and state\-certified training school. Join our team and become part of a company committed to environmental safety, professional development, and long\-term growth. Stop looking for your next job and start looking for your ideal career at JLM Environmental.

About the Role

JLM Environmental is seeking a full\-time Environmental Service Technician. This position is well suited for individuals with experience working independently in customers’ homes or businesses, particularly those who have inspected a property, explained or sold a service, and then completed an installation or provided the service.

Ideal candidates may come from field\-service backgrounds such as pest control, termite or bed bug extermination, HVAC, solar panel installation, home inspections, restoration, construction services, telecommunications installation, appliance repair, or similar customer\-facing trades.

Environmental inspection experience is not required. JLM Environmental is committed to fostering professional growth and providing opportunities for individuals to develop their expertise within the environmental consulting field. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in the field, communicating with property owners, identifying potential concerns, documenting findings, and providing excellent customer service while developing a new career trade.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct thorough surveys of clients’ properties while following established inspection and sampling procedures.
* Perform environmental hazard surveys for asbestos, lead, mold, radon, fire and smoke byproducts, methamphetamine residue, and volatile organic compounds.
* Conduct visual inspections and collect samples using proper sampling techniques.
* Clearly explain the inspection process, recommended services, and potential next steps to clients.
* Identify opportunities for additional appropriate inspection services based on property conditions and client concerns.
* Accurately complete a Chain\-of\-Custody form for each inspection. Some jobs may require multiple forms.
* Prepare detailed inspection reports containing notes about materials, locations, quantities, property conditions, and other required information.
* Deliver exceptional customer service by confidently addressing clients’ questions and concerns with respect, professionalism, and expertise.
* Manage inspection and drive time efficiently to arrive on schedule and complete assigned appointments promptly.
* Maintain inspection equipment, supplies, documentation, and assigned company property.

Position Requirements

* Proven customer service experience.
* Experience working in a field\-service, inspection, installation, sales, or customer\-facing trade is strongly preferred.
* Comfortable explaining services and recommendations to residential and commercial clients.
* Ability to identify client needs without using aggressive or high\-pressure sales tactics.
* Superb attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal communication skills.
* Exceptional writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently while following established company procedures.
* Ability to work in various environments, including indoors and outdoors, hot and cold temperatures, and inclement weather.
* Ability to properly wear Personal Protective Equipment due to potential exposure to environmental hazards such as asbestos, lead, mold, radon, methamphetamine residue, and volatile organic compounds.
* Physically capable of climbing ladders to access attics and roofs and entering confined spaces, including crawlspaces, to perform required duties.
* Ability to carry approximately 50 pounds throughout the workday.
* Availability to work approximately 40–50 hours per week.
* Ability to sit for up to 60% of the workday, including driving to job sites and completing office work.
* A motivated, dependable, and team\-oriented attitude.

Qualifications and Education

* Customer service experience required.
* High school diploma or G.E.D. required.
* Field experience in pest control, bed bug extermination, HVAC, solar installation, home inspection, restoration, construction services, or another similar trade is preferred.
* Experience selling, recommending, installing, or providing services directly to property owners is preferred.
* Must maintain a clean DMV driving record and provide a driving record upon request.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $20\.00 \- $37\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Job Posting: Northern Lands, Program Coordinator



Department of Fish and Wildlife


JC\-526357* 

Northern Lands, Program Coordinator
  

ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST
$4,418\.00 \- $9,321\.00 per Month
  

New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable.


**Final Filing Date:** **8/6/2026**


### **Job Description and Duties**


The Department is seeking a skilled and motivated land management professional to lead the stewardship of ecological reserves and other State lands, with the primary duty station at the Ballona Wetlands Ecological Reserve. This role supports the long\-term conservation of California’s natural resources through field operations, staff leadership, habitat restoration, and coordination with agency partners and the public. In this position, the selected candidate will oversee daily maintenance of Department\-managed lands, ensuring that facilities, trails, signage, fences, and infrastructure remain safe and functional for public and operational use. You’ll work alongside permanent and seasonal staff, contractors, and volunteer crews, helping ensure the lands are maintained in a collaborative effort. Duties include vegetation management, invasive species control, equipment oversight, and timely completion of routine and emergency maintenance tasks (e.g., equipment repair needs, perimeter fencing issues, addressing water leaks, etc.). You will prepare and implement adaptive management plans; conduct biological surveys; analyze habitat and species data; and assess management needs for restored, mitigation, and sensitive areas. The role includes reviewing environmental documents, obtaining necessary permits, and representing the Department on cooperative management teams and technical working groups. The position requires strong coordination with federal, State, and local agencies, neighboring landowners, land trusts and other non\-governmental organizations, volunteer groups, and academic partners. You will administer contracts, monitor funded programs, prepare reports and budgets, maintain program documentation, and help coordinate hiring and training efforts of support staff. This role involves both fieldwork and office duties, often in variable weather and rugged terrain. Overnight travel will be required up to 10%. Work hours may be 10\+ hours per day, including some night and weekend work, and may occur during varied weather conditions.  

  

  



**Personal Leave Program:** Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary salary reductions ranging from 2% to 4\.62% in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) hours. Please note that the salary ranges listed in this Job Control may not reflect these reductions associated with the 2025 Personal Leave Program.  

Please follow the link for more information regarding the 2025 Personal Leave program:  

Personal Leave Program \- Human Resources \- CalHR.  

  

  

This position may be eligible for a telework opportunity in accordance with departmental policies and operational needs. Beginning July 1, 2026, employees will be required to work in\-person at least four (4\) days per week in alignment with Executive Order N\-22\-25\. Additional in\-office days may be required based on operational needs.  

  

  

Link to Class Title Exam: Environmental Scientist*/***Exam Bulletin**

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.


### **Working Conditions**


Office will be located at Ballona Wetlands Ecological Reserve in Los Angeles OR the Cienega Springs Ecological Reserve in Fillmore. Work is conducted in office and outdoors environments, and includes highway and off\-road driving, which incorporates trail and off\-trail navigation. Driving up to 30% is an essential requirement for this position and requires a valid driver’s license, as the CDFW properties under its management require regular site visits. Many of these properties are in remote areas and span across three counties, making alternative transportation impractical. Overnight travel will be required up to 10%. Work hours may be 10\+ hours per day, including some night and weekend work, and may occur during varied weather conditions. Uniform is required when interacting with the public and while conducting fieldwork.

jobs.title: Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
Montgomery \& Associates (M\&A) is seeking a full\-time hydrogeologist to join our California team in a project\-leadership role. You'll **manage tasks and projects**, lead technical work, mentor junior staff, and work directly with clients, regulators, and M\&A project leaders — with a central focus on Sustainable Groundwater Management Act (SGMA) planning and implementation.
Founded in 1984 and headquartered in Tucson, Arizona, M\&A is a growing firm of respected water\-resource professionals expanding across the western U.S. and South America. Our California team comprises 24 professionals across four offices — Oakland, Sacramento, Monterey, and Pasadena. This position, based in **Sacramento or Oakland**, supports groundwater resource planning and SGMA implementation statewide, with a strong emphasis on Northern California and the Central Valley. Staff work at least 50% in\-office to promote collaboration and mentoring.
**What You'll Do**
* Manage and technically lead multi\-disciplinary hydrogeology and groundwater resource tasks, with a primary focus on SGMA planning and implementation
* Collaborate with our groundwater modeling team to develop hydrogeologic conceptual models and numerical models
* Design and manage field investigations, well drilling and testing, and monitoring programs, and interpret hydrogeologic data
* Prepare technical reports, proposals, and work plans; review deliverables and mentor junior staff

**Education and Professional Credentials**
Graduate degree in hydrology, geology, civil engineering, or environmental engineering, *or* professional registration (P.G. or P.E.). Both preferred; at least one required.
**Required Qualifications**
* **At least 8 years** of water resources consulting experience, preferably with substantial SGMA\-related work
* Strong command of hydrogeologic principles applied to characterizing and assessing groundwater systems, including SGMA regulatory requirements
* Task and project management experience
* Proficiency with standard analytical tools; demonstrated technical writing and group/client presentation skills
* Strong organizational, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills; team\-oriented, with experience delegating and reviewing staff deliverables
* Interest in professional organizations, including presenting at conferences

**Your benefits at Montgomery \& Associates will include:**
* Competitive benefits and salary in an expanding team\-oriented company
* Dynamic work environment with safety and technical training provided by the company
* Interesting and collaborative multidisciplinary projects
* On the job mentoring by senior professionals
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible Spending Account; HRA
* Long\- and short\-term disability
* Life/AD\&D insurance
* Vacation, holiday, personal, and sick leave
* Employer matching 401k retirement plan

Annual Base Salary Range: $94,000 \- $120,000
Annual Salary Range Including Bonuses: $105,000 \- $135,000
  

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer
*M\&A values diversity and inclusivity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, religious creed, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Associate, Biologist or Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
As a company, we aim to build a world where communities go beyond resilience, embracing change as an opportunity to enhance safety, well\-being, and quality of life. Join us to accelerate this vision and your professional development.


We are looking to add new talent to our growing team! We are currently seeking an **Associate, Biologist or Environmental Scientist** to work in a business development and senior technical lead role with highly skilled professionals on diverse project teams in a dynamic environment. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing group and company and get involved in a variety of projects for a diverse range of clients. This is a **full\-time** position located in **Seattle, WA** or **Portland, OR** office.


**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**  

***In this position, you will*****:**


* Lead and assist with identifying new client opportunities while developing internal and external networks into a book of business.
* Lead business development opportunities to assist our northwest region’s natural resources and permitting \- growth initiatives.
* Assist with the development and diversification of natural resources and permitting services in the northwest region across multiple markets (Energy, Real Estate, Industrial, Remediation…).
* Lead and assist with the execution of natural resources and permitting project work through individual contribution and delegation to lower\-level staff.
* Develop technical scopes of work and proposals within your area of expertise, connecting your work with other project components to support client goals. Recognize when conditions require modifications to meet client\- or regulatory\-specific requirements.
* Demonstrate and apply knowledge of proper jurisdictional codes, regulations, and professional standards of practice to assigned project work.
* Coach, mentor, and support staff to facilitate knowledge transfer and ensure high\-quality execution of project tasks, technical reports, and deliverables.
* Use developing skills to be visible in your specialty area by giving internal and external technical presentations and attending external networking events to identify business development opportunities.
* Play a significant leadership role in performing technical evaluations and developing conceptual site models on environmental, natural resource, and land use permitting projects.
* Lead the development of proposals and technical reporting efforts supporting natural resource, permitting/compliance, other related projects, and assist with development of documentation reporting standards.
* Work with the appropriate staff to support the design and development of restoration and mitigation design plans on various aquatic and habitat projects.
* Perform or oversee field implementation of technical resource studies, restoration/mitigation design development and implementation along with construction oversight, as needed.
* Plan and perform all work in accordance with company and client health and safety protocols.
* Demonstrate the company’s foundational safety behaviors.

**SKILLS/EXPERIENCE**  

***Minimum Skills and Requirements*****:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Environmental Science, Natural Resources, or related field.
* Minimum of 15 years related experience including 5 years of Project Management.
* Professional Wetland Scientist (PWS) certification preferred.
* Experience with local, state and federal permitting, natural resource management (species surveys and documentation), regulations/requirements and experience with wetlands in the Pacific Northwest and arid regions a must.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including verbally presenting project information to peers, stakeholders, and clients.
* Desire to advance skills in your area of expertise to become more visible in the industry.
* Environmental design and contract package development experience.
* Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks pertinent to the work.

***Preferred Skills*****:**


* Master’s degree in Natural Resource, Environmental Science, Biology, Geology, or related field.
* Experience conducting permitting/compliance with local, state, and federal regulations related to wetlands and other natural resources. Including state (SEPA) and federal (NEPA) documentation preparation and compliance.
* Experience conducting wetland and habitat evaluations to determine resource liabilities \& make recommendations on permits, design plans and mitigation requirements to achieve compliance.
* OSHA 40\-Hour HAZWOPER training and refresher updates.

The salary range for this position in **Seattle, WA** and **Portland, OR is $110,000 \- $150,000 annually**. Actual compensation will be based upon a variety of factors such as education, related work experience, certificates, skills, and current market conditions. Haley \& Aldrich reviews salary ranges each quarter to assess competitiveness with the market. **This role is eligible to participate in the company’s discretionary bonus program.** This bonus program is based on overall company performance and the results achieved compared to peers**. This role may be eligible to receive a sign\-on bonus.**

jobs.title: Archaeology Field Technician
jobs.description:
At **WestLand** Engineering and Environmental Services, a Trinity Consultants team, we are driven by purpose, innovation, and a shared commitment to the work that we do. As part of Trinity Consultants' Water and Ecology division, we tackle complex environmental challenges, blending expertise in environmental consulting, wetlands, cultural resources, GIS, landscape architecture, and engineering.

**WestLand** empowers our teams to develop their unique skills while fostering career growth within a company that is large enough to offer diverse opportunities yet agile enough to value individual contributions. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do\-our professionals work together on meaningful and impactful projects, delivering solutions that help clients navigate regulatory complexities and see positive project outcomes. Make a difference with us at WestLand!

**WestLand** is seeking on\-call Archaeology Field Technicians for our growing Washington and Oregon teams. Our crews can be found working throughout the West on CRM projects for private and public sector clients. For out\-of\-town work that includes overnight, or longer duration stays, per diem and single\-occupancy hotel rooms are provided. The successful candidates can be based out of either WestLand's Portland, Seattle, or Spokane offices.


What will I be doing?

* Under the direction of a field supervisor, conducting archaeological field work (field survey, testing, monitoring, and data recovery excavations).
* Under direction of field supervisor, recording artifacts, features and other manifestations using Trimble GIS, map archaeological features and sites, draw scaled profiles and plans, and maintain paperwork, notes, and records.
* Processing and cataloging artifacts and other materials under lab staff supervision.
* Performing preliminary analysis and lab tasks under lab staff supervision.
* Filing and scanning records and paperwork.
* Completing record searches and report tables under supervision of senior staff.


What qualifications are required for this role?

* Associate degree or higher in Archaeology, Anthropology, or a related field. Prior on\-the\-job archeology experience may substitute for educational requirements.
* Previous experience in archaeology preferred.
* Ability to conduct fieldwork for long hours in environments featuring extreme temperatures, rough terrain, and potential high altitudes.
* Ability to carry up to 60 pounds of equipment and supplies.
* Ability to bend and kneel for long periods of time.
* Ability to travel out of town for work throughout the West, often on short notice and for extended periods (paid drive time, per diem and/or hotel provided).
* Ability to work as a member of a cohesive team.
* Ability to work in a fast paced and creative environment.


The salary range for this position is $26\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour


What does WestLand offer you?

* Comprehensive benefits package: 9 paid holidays, healthcare benefits, PTO, and 401k matching for full\-time employees. Flexible work schedules and remote/hybrid possibilities for most roles.
* Multidisciplinary environment: Unique, creative, and challenging projects where you can develop your vision of clientele and work with industry leaders daily.
* Success\-oriented environment: Two\-way mentorship, financial incentives to publish work, tuition reimbursement, and a career\-path structure to help you reach the next steps in your career.
* Collaborative work environment: Clear and frequent communication, shared information and ideas across teams, and a welcoming atmosphere for everyone.

**WestLand** is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We maintain a drug\-free workplace and perform pre\-employment background checks.


To apply, visit WestLand Resources Job Listings

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst II, Reporting & Advanced Analytics Part Time 26-84
new_jobs.description:
**We’re delighted you’re considering joining us!**


At Hill Physicians Medical Group, we’re shaping the healthcare of the future: actively managed care that prevents disease, supports those with chronic conditions and anticipates the needs of our members.

**Join Our Team!**


Hill Physicians has much to offer prospective employees. We’re regularly recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work in the Bay Area” and have been recognized as one of the “Healthiest Places to Work in the Bay Area.” When you join our team, you’re making a great choice for your professional career and your personal satisfaction.

**DE\&I Statement:**


At PriMed, your uniqueness is valued, celebrated, encouraged, supported, and embraced. Whatever your relationship with Hill Physicians, we welcome ALL that you are.


We value and respect your race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, disabilities, experiences, perspectives, and other attributes. Our celebration of diversity and foundation of inclusion allows us to leverage our differences and capitalize on our similarities to better serve our communities. We do it because it's right!

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The Data Analyst **Part Time** supports data\-informed initiatives, including clinical quality, financial performance, and population health by gathering, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data as a compelling story to the Hill Physicians team and its collaborating partners. Within this classification, analysts may focus on reporting and visualization, or analytical consultation and modeling. Data Analysts work as members of teams committed to using and promoting industry\-standard best practices and to addressing new problems with innovative solutions.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Transform data into actionable insights with narrative to drive strategic and operational decisions
* Conduct driver analysis to identify key factors influencing health outcomes and predict future utilization of health care services
* Provide consultation to internal stakeholders in understanding and responding to HPMG performance as measured by external bodies, e.g., health plans and the Integrated Healthcare Association, as well as variations in internal clinical and financial metrics
* Assist internal and external stakeholders with appropriate use of standardized reports, analytical approaches to population management and quality improvement programs, and program effectiveness evaluation
* Serve as analytical liaison with internal stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of data requirements and fostering collaboration to drive data\-driven decision\-making
* Use business understanding to appropriately implement logic specifications
* Independently develop analytic plan to address business questions
* Prepare presentations for non\-technical audiences
* Provide guidance and support to junior analysts, helping them develop their skills and understanding of data analysis and familiarity with data sets
* Utilize advanced querying techniques for complex data manipulation and statistical analyses

**Data Governance \& Compliance**

* Proactively perform quality assurance on all deliverables including researching and reconciling data discrepancies occurring among various information systems and reports
* Maintain high data quality standards to ensure that reports and analyses are accurate, timely, and reliable, enabling confident decision\-making
* Improve the organization’s quality assurance procedures
* Collaborate with appropriate IT teams and business stewards to improve the quality of data and information flows at Hill Physicians
* Ensure compliance with data governance frameworks and healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA

**Knowledge, Experience \& Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, business, informatics, statistics, public health, or related field with coursework in quantitative analysis
* Master’s degree preferred
* Minimum 3 years of professional analytics\-related experience.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment, prioritize multiple projects and problem\-solve under tight deadlines and resource constraints
* Excellent written and interpersonal communication skills and presentation skills, including ability to present complex technical concepts in a clear, concise manner to audiences with varying levels of technical understanding
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and to function as an integral part of a team in a rapidly changing work environment, and to operate effectively with limited direction from management
* Intermediate understanding of healthcare\-specific datasets, including claims, clinical, and authorization data, with the ability to perform data extraction and analysis.
* Can independently solve moderately complex analytic problems and generate insights that inform decision\-making within specific business areas
* Understanding of data pipelines from source systems (e.g. EPIC) into data warehousing or other downstream data sources
* Experience with chronic disease identification, utilization trending, outlier analysis, quality metrics, and tracking of other health performance indicators.
* Proficiency in Microsoft suite, including pivot tables and advanced formulas and functions
* Proficiency in querying languages such as SQL
* Experience with advanced data visualization tools such as Tableau or GIS software (ArcGIS) preferred
* Experience with advanced analytic programs/languages such as SAS or R preferred

**Additional Information:**


Salary: $48,700\.00 \- $63,925\.00 Annual

**Hill Physicians is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

new_jobs.title: Archaeology Field Technician
new_jobs.description:
At **WestLand** Engineering and Environmental Services, a Trinity Consultants team, we are driven by purpose, innovation, and a shared commitment to the work that we do. As part of Trinity Consultants' Water and Ecology division, we tackle complex environmental challenges, blending expertise in environmental consulting, wetlands, cultural resources, GIS, landscape architecture, and engineering.

**WestLand** empowers our teams to develop their unique skills while fostering career growth within a company that is large enough to offer diverse opportunities yet agile enough to value individual contributions. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do\-our professionals work together on meaningful and impactful projects, delivering solutions that help clients navigate regulatory complexities and see positive project outcomes. Make a difference with us at WestLand!

**WestLand** is seeking on\-call Archaeology Field Technicians for our growing Washington and Oregon teams. Our crews can be found working throughout the West on CRM projects for private and public sector clients. For out\-of\-town work that includes overnight, or longer duration stays, per diem and single\-occupancy hotel rooms are provided. The successful candidates can be based out of either WestLand's Portland, Seattle, or Spokane offices.


What will I be doing?

* Under the direction of a field supervisor, conducting archaeological field work (field survey, testing, monitoring, and data recovery excavations).
* Under direction of field supervisor, recording artifacts, features and other manifestations using Trimble GIS, map archaeological features and sites, draw scaled profiles and plans, and maintain paperwork, notes, and records.
* Processing and cataloging artifacts and other materials under lab staff supervision.
* Performing preliminary analysis and lab tasks under lab staff supervision.
* Filing and scanning records and paperwork.
* Completing record searches and report tables under supervision of senior staff.


What qualifications are required for this role?

* Associate degree or higher in Archaeology, Anthropology, or a related field. Prior on\-the\-job archeology experience may substitute for educational requirements.
* Previous experience in archaeology preferred.
* Ability to conduct fieldwork for long hours in environments featuring extreme temperatures, rough terrain, and potential high altitudes.
* Ability to carry up to 60 pounds of equipment and supplies.
* Ability to bend and kneel for long periods of time.
* Ability to travel out of town for work throughout the West, often on short notice and for extended periods (paid drive time, per diem and/or hotel provided).
* Ability to work as a member of a cohesive team.
* Ability to work in a fast paced and creative environment.


The salary range for this position is $26\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour


What does WestLand offer you?

* Comprehensive benefits package: 9 paid holidays, healthcare benefits, PTO, and 401k matching for full\-time employees. Flexible work schedules and remote/hybrid possibilities for most roles.
* Multidisciplinary environment: Unique, creative, and challenging projects where you can develop your vision of clientele and work with industry leaders daily.
* Success\-oriented environment: Two\-way mentorship, financial incentives to publish work, tuition reimbursement, and a career\-path structure to help you reach the next steps in your career.
* Collaborative work environment: Clear and frequent communication, shared information and ideas across teams, and a welcoming atmosphere for everyone.

**WestLand** is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We maintain a drug\-free workplace and perform pre\-employment background checks.


To apply, visit WestLand Resources Job Listings

*Resumes submitted by a recruiting/staffing agency without current/valid vendor agreement will become property of WestLand. Any recruiting/staffing agency wishing to do business with WestLand must contact the Human Resources Department through our website. Recruiting/staffing agents may NOT contact hiring managers directly. Firms that do not honor this request will be removed from consideration.*
